question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics be accepted as a core Doctor contribution now, or remain paused until the ownership stack and RFC direction receive explicit sponsorship?
rationale: The patch adds a new core lifecycle/health product surface rather than repairing an established broken contract, and its base dependency is still open.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core diagnostic
options.body: Accept the experiment-gated Doctor contribution after the MCP ownership base is approved and the author supplies current-head real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause for stack sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until a Claws owner confirms the core diagnostic scope and landing order for the RFC stack.

recommendation.title: Pause for stack sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until a Claws owner confirms the core diagnostic scope and landing order for the RFC stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the most specific visible review guidance on the correctness contract for the new diagnostics.
